title: DisconnectCommand
body:
The mod adds the /disconnect command, which simply disconnects you from the server.
I think this could be useful.
Couldn't find such plugin on the internet, so I made my own.


![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5dcb82d66072b124bea2a8e68ad90685c8b56ca8.gif)
